description.message: 这个浏览器扩展为文本框添加类似 bash shell 的键盘快捷键。

delete_to_the_end_of_the_line.description: Delete to the end of the line

move_cursor_to_the_next_character.message: 将光标移到下一个字符
move_cursor_to_the_next_character.description: Move cursor to the next character

move_cursor_to_the_previous_character.message: 将光标移到上一个字符
move_cursor_to_the_previous_character.description: Move cursor to the previous character

move_cursor_to_the_next_word.message: 将光标移到下一个单词

move_cursor_to_the_previous_word.message: 将光标移到上一个单词

delete_to_the_beginning_of_the_line.description: Delete to the beginning of the line

tooltip_default_policy.message: 当没有任何规则匹配时应用

tooltip_match_type.message: exact：整个 URL。glob：* 限于单个路径段，** 可跨越 /。regex：JavaScript 正则表达式
tooltip_match_type.description: exact: whole URL. glob: * stays in one segment, ** crosses /. regex: JavaScript RegExp

tooltip_rule_action.message: allow 启用快捷键，deny 停用快捷键
tooltip_rule_action.description: allow enables the keybindings, deny disables them

tooltip_rule_order.message: 规则自上而下依次匹配，以第一条匹配的规则为准
tooltip_rule_order.description: Rules apply top to bottom; the first match wins

tooltip_language_select.message: 覆盖选项页面的显示语言；auto 表示跟随浏览器设置
tooltip_language_select.description: Overrides the options page language; auto follows the browser
